description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Invenergy is hiring a Dynamics 365 / Power Platform Developer to design, develop, and support secure, scalable business applications. The role supports business processes, reporting, integrations, and user experience using Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform.
Platform Developer I supporting Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions through development, customization, and Power Automate workflows

Responsibilities:
• Assist in the completion of projects and tasks related to Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions while learning professional concepts and foundational development practices
• Support the design, development, and maintenance of solutions using Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps), Dataverse, Power Automate, and Power BI under the guidance of senior team members
• Assist with customization and configuration of Dynamics 365 entities, forms, views, business rules, dashboards, and security roles
• Support the development of Power Automate flows to assist with business processes, integrations, and automations
• Assist in supporting existing applications, troubleshooting issues, and performing enhancements with guidance from senior developers
• Apply knowledge and basic problem-solving techniques to define and resolve clearly scoped problems; receive instruction on day-to-day work and new assignments

Requirements:
• Foundational awareness of Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven) and Power Automate development concepts
• Basic understanding of Dataverse, including tables, relationships, security roles, and data modeling
• Exposure to or coursework in JavaScript, C#, or related programming languages for client-side and server-side development
• Basic analytical skills with the ability to support translation of business requirements into technical solutions
• No prior professional experience required
• Bachelor's Degree required
• Eligible to work in the United States without employer visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred:
• internship, academic project, or coursework experience in a relevant field is a plus
• Awareness of Azure services such as Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, or Azure DevOps
• Familiarity with Power BI reports and datasets, including DAX measures and data models
• Knowledge of SQL Server, Azure SQL, or data warehousing concepts
• Exposure to agile delivery environments
• Microsoft certifications related to Power Platform or Dynamics 365
